description: Reviewed decisions for tools/validate-listen-for-alignment.mjs. Each entry is a Turn-and-Talk whose listen-for the detector flags as answering a different question, but which a human read and judged correct as written. Entry shape: { lessonId, index (turnAndTalk position), reason (40+ characters) }. An entry whose finding no longer fires FAILS and must be deleted — stale absolutions are worse than no file.
